directions.s: Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME SPRITE POSE SHEET for OAVEN matching the attached concept and parts reference, not a concept scene. WIDE LANDSCAPE 3:1 composition, exactly SIX columns and TWO rows, 12 separate full-body figures with generous pure MAGENTA #FF00FF gutters and background, no text, no ground or cast shadows. All figures face SOUTH: straight toward camera, seen from elevated RTS camera about 35 degrees above horizontal; see top of head and shoulders. Identity: small biped insect/reptile-like creature, huge rounded blue-teal chitin head, enormous luminous cyan compound eyes, very short broad blunt face, tiny crown spines and thin antennae; NO RAT anatomy, no mammal ears, no fur, no long muzzle. Short wiry body, dark ragged charcoal tunic, muted red scarf and wrist wraps, blue clawed hands/feet, thin segmented blue tail. Clean hand-drawn bold ink contour, controlled painted shading in large planes, crisp edges, readable silhouette. Weapons rough wood spear with stone point, short wooden blowpipe. Row TOP: wingless Oaven. Row BOTTOM: same Oaven Jumper with FOUR cyan dragonfly wings attached behind shoulders. In BOTH rows the SIX columns are 1 idle holding spear upright; 2 running contact A with left leg forward holding spear; 3 running contact B right leg forward holding spear; 4 thrust spear toward viewer with visible foreshortening, low aggressive stance; 5 firing a short blowpipe pressed to mouth aimed toward viewer, spear put away; 6 dead collapsed full-body pose, curled grounded limbs and fallen weapon, wings folded/spread on ground for Jumper. Each pose completely contained in its own equal-width sixth, even weapons and wing tips. Consistent head/body scale across all twelve poses. Keep the very large eyes and red scarf, NOT a human goblin, NOT a ratman. No glow haze outside contours, no environmental details. References establish identity only, draw complete figures.

directions.nw: Create a new production sprite sheet of the attached Oaven, changing EVERY figure to face BACK-LEFT (NORTHWEST). EXACTLY six columns by two rows of full body poses, solid magenta background, no text. TOP row wingless Oaven, BOTTOM row same Oaven with four dragonfly wings. This is the reverse angle of the attached rear-RIGHT sheet. In EVERY standing/running/firing pose the NOSE IS ON THE LEFT EDGE OF THE HEAD and only a little cyan eye is visible at the LEFT edge, the BACK of the head and BACK of the tunic face the viewer, red scarf knot visible on back. Tail goes behind to screen RIGHT. Never show an eye on the right side of the head; NEVER face upper right. Columns: 1 idle spear upright; 2 run left foot contact; 3 run right foot contact; 4 spear thrust toward UPPER LEFT; 5 blowpipe pressed to unseen mouth aiming UPPER LEFT; 6 collapsed corpse facing UPPER LEFT showing back of head and body. Camera elevated 35 degrees. Lock same huge round blue armored head, tiny spines, ragged gray tunic, muted RED scarf, blue clawed hands and feet, segmented tail. No mammals, fur or ears. Inked hand-painted crisp style, same proportions, lighting and scale as reference. Wide sheet, generous empty gutters, each full pose INCLUDING weapon and wing tips must fit inside its sixth. ROTATE ALL SIX POSES, NOT JUST THE ATTACK.
